title: Home Protection Plans Terms: Cancellation, Free-Look Refunds and Fee Line Corrections
content:
Terms governing cancellation of a plan in the Home Protection Plans line, the refund of plan fees on cancellation, and the correction of an over-billed fee line.

## Clauses

**1. Cancellation at any time.** Where the plan's minimum term is 0 months (month-to-month), as it is for every plan in the line, the customer may cancel at any time with no cancellation fee. Cancellation is effective on the cancel date.

**2. Free look.** When the cancel date is no later than the plan's free look period, 30 calendar days for every plan in the line, after the enrollment date, and no claim has been paid on the plan, every fee line billed on the plan is refunded, with one free-look refund for each fee line.

**3. After the free look.** Otherwise, no billed month is refunded, in keeping with the plan's refund basis of no refund of billed months.

**4. One refund or correction per fee line.** Each fee line is refunded or corrected only once. Whether a fee line has already been refunded or corrected is read from the plan's billing lines: a free-look refund or a rebill credit that names that fee line.

**5. Correcting an over-billed fee line.** An over-billed fee line is corrected with one rebill credit when the customer disputes it within the plan's billing dispute lookback, counted in calendar months from the posting of the fee line. A care agent may post refunds up to the agent adjustment limit per line.

## Free-look outcomes

| Cancel date no later than 30 calendar days after enrollment | A claim has been paid on the plan | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Every billed fee line refunded, one free-look refund each |
| Yes | Yes | No billed month refunded |
| No | No | No billed month refunded |
| No | Yes | No billed month refunded |

## Illustrations (hypothetical dates and fees)

1. **Free-look boundary.** Enrolled 1 May. The thirtieth calendar day after enrollment is 31 May. A cancellation dated 31 May is within the free look; one dated 1 June is not.
2. **Two fee lines refunded.** Enrolled 20 May, with fee lines billed for May and June, no claim paid, cancelled 15 June. The cancellation is 26 days after enrollment, so both fee lines are refunded: two free-look refunds, one naming the May line and one naming the June line.
3. **Claim paid.** Enrolled 2 March, a claim paid on 25 March, cancelled 28 March. Although the cancellation is within 30 days, a claim has been paid, so no billed month is refunded.
4. **Already refunded.** A fee line that already carries a free-look refund is not corrected again with a rebill credit.
